project.title: Green Monster Ware Haus
project.creative_rule: Each protagonist is a fictional figure informed by the artist's documented practice, not a literal portrait or invented biography.

monster.name: The Green Warehouse Organism
monster.setting: A dark industrial art warehouse in Neukölln, Berlin
appearance: flowers and seed pods growing from the crown
plant, animal, human and machine anatomy
monster.story: After the artists leave fragments of paintings, drawings, sounds, performances, objects and memories inside the warehouse, the materials connect through the electrical system and grow into a living organism.
monster.image_prompt: The Green Warehouse Organism standing full-body inside a rough Neukölln industrial art space. A long green botanical face, luminous yellow eyes, enormous leaf ears, flowers, roots, branches, cables and suspended lamps. Handmade colored-pencil, pastel and painted textures combined with cinematic warehouse lighting. Strange, humorous, poetic and contemporary rather than violent.
